prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need strategy, creative, media buying, personalization, or MarTech/analytics implementation. I can, however, help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me give a tailored shortlist:

- What is your budget range (monthly or project)?
- Company size and industry (startup, DTC, enterprise, entertainment, etc.)?
- Primary goals (customer acquisition, personalization, content generation, ad optimization, analytics/attribution)?
- Which channels matter most (paid social, search, email, web personalization, programmatic)?
- Do you need vendor/platform integration (e.g., Salesforce, Braze, Adobe, Google Cloud)?

If you want to evaluate agencies yourself, use these selection criteria:
- Relevant case studies and measurable outcomes (ROAS, CAC, conversion lift)
- Experience with your industry and channels
- Depth of AI capability (in-house data scientists vs. reselling tools)
- Clarify what is proprietary AI vs. off‑the‑shelf models
- Data privacy and compliance practices
- Ability to run a short pilot with clear KPIs
- Team composition (strategy, creative, data engineering, ML)
- Pricing model and contract flexibility

Questions to ask prospective agencies:
- Can you show results from a previous client with similar goals?
- Which ML/AI tools and platforms do you use and why?
- How do you measure success and report performance?
- Who will be on our account and what are their qualifications?
- What does a 90-day pilot engagement look like and what will it deliver?

If you’d like, I can:
- Assemble a short list (3–5) of LA-based AI marketing agencies matched to your answers above
- Draft an RFP or pilot brief you can send to agencies
- Provide suggested interview questions and an evaluation scorecard

Which of those would you like me to do next?
